purpose: Read exactly native frame 0 for the existing coarse, medium, and fine F1-S2 runs to check finite fluid support, typed roles, divider disjointness, and native header semantics against the separately defined 340 kg continuous owner.

owner_continuum.mass_semantics: continuous closed axis-aligned owner box; native particle mass remains a separate discrete diagnostic

position_support_tolerance.reason: This tolerance records finite-precision containment at the source support boundary and is not a position, integration, or spatial-truth task tolerance.

required_checks: all decoded native fields are finite and Idp is unique
fluid positions are inside the continuous owner box within the separately registered binary support tolerance
fluid positions do not overlap the source XML asymmetric divider drawbox within that diagnostic tolerance
XML typed ranges assign every decoded identity and preserve mkfluid-relative versus absolute-mk roles
native MassFluid and Dp are reported from the decoder; native sample mass is not substituted for 340 kg
selected Part source SHA/stat are stable before and after the parent-reserved decode

qualification.reason: Initial finite/support and header diagnostics do not establish spatial truth, temporal/integration error, producer world-axis calibration, or external validation.
